items.item_text: BLS from the American Red Cross or American Heart Association, required
Nursing Professional Leadership Certificate highly desirable
5 years of acute adult inpatient psychiatric experience as an RN, required
2 years or greater of charge RN or leadership experience as an RN, required

At UCLA Health, our commitment to patient care shines brightest during life’s most challenging moments. Our clinicians embody hope and healing, delivering compassionate, expert care with empathy and assurance. If you're passionate about advancing nursing excellence, we invite you to join our team.

As a Clinical Nurse Manager, you will support the Unit Director in leading the daily clinical and operational activities of a highly acute psychiatric inpatient unit. You will coordinate staffing based on patient acuity and skill mix, support patient flow, and promote safe, high-quality, patient-centered care in alignment with organizational policies and regulatory standards.

In this role, you will supervise non-RN clinical staff, provide coaching and performance feedback, and foster a collaborative environment grounded in empathy, respect, and accountability. Working closely with nursing staff, physicians, and interdisciplinary partners, you will lead unit-based performance improvement initiatives, strengthen workflows, and promote staff engagement, professional development, and shared governance.
Attainment of progressive leadership positions highly desirable
Skill in implementing appropriate nursing interventions on a consistent basis
Ability to perform historical, physical and behavioral patient assessment
